# Generated by gen_v122_imperial_roads.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Calendar month counter for once-per-month deduplication.
oe_road_month_now = {
	value = current_year
	multiply = 12
	add = current_month
}

# Country scope. Treasury gold reserve floor (tiers: 1=300, 2=800, 3=1500 [default], 4=3000, 5=5000).
oe_road_floor_value = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_road_floor_tier ?= 1 }
		value = 300
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_road_floor_tier ?= 2 }
		value = 800
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_road_floor_tier ?= 4 }
		value = 3000
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_road_floor_tier ?= 5 }
		value = 5000
	}
	else = {
		value = 1500
	}
}

# Country scope. Estimated per-segment cost safety buffer above floor to prevent treasury overdraft.
oe_road_tier_buffer_value = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_road_tier_policy ?= 2 }
		value = 40
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root } }
		value = 320
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root }
				road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root }
			}
		}
		value = 180
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root }
				road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root }
				road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root }
				road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root }
			}
		}
		value = 100
	}
	else = {
		value = 40
	}
}

# Country scope. Safe treasury threshold required before queuing each road segment.
oe_road_safe_gold = {
	value = oe_road_floor_value
	add = oe_road_tier_buffer_value
}

# Country scope. Monthly segment pacing cap (2 = conservative, 5 = standard [default], 10 = imperial mega-build).
oe_road_pacing_cap = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_road_cap_tier ?= 1 }
		value = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_road_cap_tier ?= 3 }
		value = 10
	}
	else = {
		value = 5
	}
}

# Location scope. Unified candidate priority score dispatching across all 3 smart routing modes.
oe_road_location_priority = {
	value = 10

	# --- Mode 1 (default): Imperial Proximity & Control Network ---
	if = {
		limit = {
			root = {
				NOT = { var:oe_road_mode ?= 2 }
				NOT = { var:oe_road_mode ?= 3 }
			}
		}
		add = { value = population multiply = 4 }
		add = { value = location_tax_base multiply = 15 }
		if = { limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis } add = 260 }
		else_if = { limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city } add = 180 }
		else_if = { limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town } add = 110 }
		if = { limit = { has_road_to_capital = no } add = 120 }
		if = { limit = { num_roads = 0 } add = 90 }
		if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod } add = 180 }
		if = { limit = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace } add = 220 }
	}

	# --- Mode 2: Market & Manufactories Commercial Network ---
	else_if = {
		limit = { root = { var:oe_road_mode ?= 2 } }
		if = { limit = { is_market_center = yes } add = 320 }
		if = { limit = { oe_road_has_v118_manufactory = yes } add = 280 }
		if = { limit = { is_port = yes } add = 150 }
		if = { limit = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col2_charter_customs_house } add = 140 }
		if = { limit = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_recruitment_bureau } add = 160 }
		if = { limit = { market_access < 0.70 } add = 140 }
		if = { limit = { market_access < 0.45 } add = 90 }
		add = { value = location_tax_base multiply = 18 }
		if = { limit = { num_roads = 0 } add = 60 }
	}

	# --- Mode 3: Culture 2.0 Organic Assimilation Sprint Network ---
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = dominant_culture
				NOT = { dominant_culture ?= root.culture }
			}
			add = 300
			# Prime target: hovering right below oe_cul2's 0.50 (Tier 1A) and 0.65 (Tier 1B) assimilation gates!
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_control >= 0.20
					local_control < 0.65
				}
				add = 260
				if = {
					limit = {
						local_control >= 0.35
						local_control < 0.50
					}
					add = 180
				}
			}
			# Towns/Cities with cultural/educational buildings ready to flip into +25% / +40% oe_cul2 surge!
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						location_rank = location_rank:town
						location_rank = location_rank:city
						location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
					}
				}
				add = 140
				if = {
					limit = { oe_road_has_cul2_academy_building = yes }
					add = 220
				}
			}
			# Immediately abolish oe_cul2 Tier 3A/3B unroaded friction (-35% / -50% when num_roads = 0)!
			if = {
				limit = { num_roads = 0 }
				add = 160
			}
			# Golden Loop: freshly chartered colonial towns with 10-year Frontier Integration Boost!
			if = {
				limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod }
				add = 450
			}
			add = { value = population multiply = 3 }
		}
		else = {
			# Secondary fallback once non-primary hubs are linked: connect unroaded colonial/frontier hubs.
			if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod } add = 200 }
			if = { limit = { num_roads = 0 } add = 40 }
			add = { value = population multiply = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope (this = neighbor candidate). Chooses best anchor hub to connect toward.
oe_road_neighbor_anchor_score = {
	value = proximity
	multiply = 5
	if = { limit = { is_capital = yes } add = 500 }
	if = { limit = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace } add = 260 }
	if = { limit = { is_market_center = yes } add = 240 }
	if = { limit = { is_port = yes } add = 120 }
	if = { limit = { has_road_to_capital = yes } add = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { var:oe_road_mode ?= 2 } }
		add = { value = market_access multiply = 200 }
	}
}

oe_road_rd_enabled = { if = { limit = { var:oe_road_auto_enabled ?= 1 } value = 1 } else = { value = 0 } }

	if = { limit = { var:oe_road_mode ?= 2 } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { var:oe_road_mode ?= 3 } value = 3 }
	else = { value = 1 }
}

oe_road_rd_gold = { value = gold }

	value = 0

}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_road_cul2_segments } add = var:oe_road_cul2_segments }
}

	# 7=Railroad, 6=Siberian Trakt, 5=Modern, 4=Via Imperialis, 3=Yam Post, 2=Paved, 1=Gravel, 0=None
	if = { limit = { road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root } } value = 7 }
	else_if = { limit = { road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root } } value = 6 }
	else_if = { limit = { road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root } } value = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root } } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root } } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root } } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { road_type:gravel_road = { is_available_for = root } } value = 1 }
